_doc: OD-1108-DISPOSITIONS-2 H13 (owner 2026-11-08, supersedes OD-1106-ROBOTS-AI): hyperscaler-specific robots blocks are advisory for independently identified VERA-DAR agents. Binding: a group naming ANY own_tokens product token (RFC 9309, all matching own groups must allow), else the * group; and a comment stating that AI crawlers/assistants are blocked (robots_ai_statement). advisory_agent_tokens: a group naming only these tokens NEVER denies (robots_ai.advisory records it); their Crawl-delay still applies as polite pacing. usage_tokens map a usage-purpose token to an informational signal (never blocks, no * fallback). Use signals (Content-Signal ai-input, Content-Usage ai-use, TDM) and terms are enforced elsewhere. Fails closed.
ai_statement_phrases: ai crawlers and assistants are blocked
ai crawlers and assistants are not permitted
